message.content:
The illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters at the top. Below, a subtitle reads "50 Tahun!". Additional text at the top reads "PENUNGGANG KOMPONEN CADANGAN" on the left and "BUKTI BARU PEMERKOSAAN ANAK LUWU TIMUR" on the right.

The main image shows a woman with dark hair and glasses, wearing a dark gray jacket and trousers. She is in a dynamic pose, leaning forward while holding a long, thin gray pole. Attached to the pole's end is a net containing a large, reddish-brown, spiny oval cluster resembling an oil palm fruit bunch. From this net and the fruit cluster, several pieces of paper money—Indonesian Rupiah banknotes in red and purple—are falling through the air.

The woman holds the pole with both hands, her body positioned in the lower-left. A landscape with palm tree silhouettes is visible in the background under a blue-toned sky with light clouds. A large title in bold black letters on the left reads "SULAP PAJAK SAWIT GELAP," followed by smaller text explaining tax issues. A barcode, QR code, and publication details ("18-24 OKTOBER 2021") are in the bottom right.
